name: @dzup-ui/docs
description: Public documentation site for dzup-ui (TASK-N2-D1) — a renderer over packages/core/docs/component-meta.json, never a second source of API facts

scripts.//generate: TASK-N2-D1. Emits every generated page under apps/docs/components/ from packages/core/docs/component-meta.json. Asserts the artifact is FRESH first (the same re-extract-and-compare clause `yarn validate:component-meta` runs), so a stale artifact stops the site build before a single page is written.
scripts.dev: yarn generate && yarn playground && vitepress dev
scripts.//build: The generate step is part of the build on purpose: a stale metadata artifact must turn the SITE build red, not just a separate validator.
scripts.build: yarn generate && yarn playground && vitepress build
scripts.//playground: TASK-N2-D3. Runs the SINGLE playground bundle producer (apps/storybook/scripts/build-playground.mjs) and copies its three assets here. Not a second bundler -- the same one-producer/N-consumers shape TASK-N2-A3 gave apps/storybook/scripts/build-llms.mjs. --check asserts the copies are byte-identical to the producer output.
